name: Don't Steal My Heart
source:
It's just another normal night for you as a security guard, until a jewel thief breaks in! He's a smooth talker, just what will you do?

[Edited from [url=https://kalamosgames.itch.io/dont-steal-my-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对于一名保安来说，这只是另一个正常的夜晚，直到珠宝窃贼闯入！他是个能说会道的人，你会怎么做呢？
